known_edge_cases: a genuine two-column resume with a very short (3-line) sidebar against a long (20-line) main column

RESOLVED (2026-08): originally a KNOWN LIMITATION found during Milestone 1 validation -- MIN_BAND_BALANCE_RATIO=0.25 in layout.py rejected this real layout (actual balance 3/20=0.15) and classified it as 'ambiguous' instead of 'two_column'. Fixed by the same row-pitch-continuity change that fixed right_aligned_dates_ats's false positive (see docs/architecture/ResumeIntelligenceEngine.md Section 4.2 implementation note and Milestone1_ValidationReport.md): the sidebar's own rows are single-spaced (pitch ratio 1.0 against the main column), which is what actually makes it a real column -- its short line COUNT (3) was never the relevant signal. Now correctly classifies as 'two_column' (confidence 0.6).
notes: Validation-pass fixture (2026-08), fix verified (2026-08). This finding and right_aligned_dates_ats's were resolved by the SAME change, not two separate fixes -- both were symptoms of using line-count balance as a proxy for 'is this a real column' instead of measuring row-pitch continuity directly. Now a permanent regression fixture (expected_layout.json added) rather than smoke-only.
